name: Tundrid Hills
summary: Snowbound ridges cut across the Tundrid Hills in south-central Dun Morogh, west of the Gol'Bolar Quarry. Dangerous wildlife keeps travelers to the rocky passes at their peril.

sections.title: A Treacherous Wilderness
sections.body: The Tundrid Hills offer a rough route from Coldridge Valley to eastern Dun Morogh, away from the main roads through Kharanos. Jagged, snowy slopes make the crossing dangerous. Ferocious predators prowl the hills, so travelers who leave the beaten path face peril without a drawn weapon.

faq.q: Where are the Tundrid Hills located?
faq.answer: The Tundrid Hills cross south-central Dun Morogh, west of the Gol'Bolar Quarry. They rise south of the main road from Kharanos to the eastern lands.

faq.q: Why would anyone travel through the Tundrid Hills?
faq.answer: You can cross the Tundrid Hills overland from Coldridge Valley to eastern Dun Morogh, bypassing the established settlement routes. The ridges are far more hazardous than the patrolled roads.

faq.q: What threats can be found in the Tundrid Hills?
faq.answer: Fierce wildlife adapted to the freezing heights lives in the Tundrid Hills. Few travelers venture there without a weapon at hand.

angles.text: As a mountaineer of Ironforge, you know these heights remind you that wilderness and hostile Frostmane trolls press close to Dun Morogh's heartland.
As a hunter, you can track hardy beasts adapted to Dun Morogh's punishing mountain chill across these wind-battered crags.
